If you like the idea of working on advertising campaigns for some of the biggest and highest-performing brands in the world, learning from experienced marketers, and developing skills at the cutting edge of the performance marketing industry, then this is for you. About The Role We're looking for ambitious, curious, and driven individuals who want to build a career in marketing and advertising. You don't need previous experience in marketing or copywriting. We're open to candidates from different educational and professional backgrounds who demonstrate the right aptitude, communication skills, work ethic, and willingness to learn. You'll receive structured, hands-on training in advertising, customer psychology, direct-response marketing, and copywriting. You'll work alongside experienced team members, study successful advertising campaigns, and learn how to develop ideas and turn them into advertising creative for major eCommerce brands. This is an opportunity to develop a valuable professional skill set while contributing to real advertising campaigns from the beginning. Your Responsibilities -Research & Learning Study successful advertising campaigns and learn what makes them effective. Research products, customers, competitors, and different advertising angles. Develop an understanding of marketing, customer psychology, and advertising principles. -Creative Ideation Generate ideas for advertising hooks, stories, and creative concepts. Develop and refine ideas based on feedback from senior team members. -Copywriting & Execution Learn to write persuasive advertising copy for different formats and products. Turn approved ideas into advertising scripts, hooks, stories, and other creative assets. Rewrite and adapt existing winning advertisements to explore new angles and approaches. Use AI tools to support research, ideation, and creative production. -Improvement & Collaboration Work closely with senior team members to improve the quality of your work. Apply feedback, make revisions, and continuously develop your skills. Take ownership of assignments and manage your workload independently. Requirements / Who We're Looking For -No previous marketing or copywriting experience is required. We're more interested in your aptitude, attitude, and potential than your resume. We're looking for people who: Have excellent written and spoken English (Native or near-native fluency). Are curious, ambitious, and genuinely interested in learning how marketing and advertising work. Communicate clearly and confidently, ask questions, and aren't afraid to challenge ideas when appropriate. Are resourceful and capable of figuring things out independently rather than constantly relying on direction. Are coachable, receptive to feedback, and motivated to improve. Have strong attention to detail and take pride in the quality of their work. Have a strong work ethic and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Are comfortable using technology and willing to learn new tools, including AI. -Relevant backgrounds could include: Recent graduates or university students. People interested in marketing, advertising, business, or psychology. Sales professionals and people in communication-heavy roles. Hospitality professionals, including waiters, concierges, and customer-facing staff. Individuals looking to transition into marketing from another industry. A degree or previous professional experience is not required. Demonstrated ability, initiative, and potential matter more. This Role Is NOT For You If You're looking for a job where you can do the bare minimum and collect a paycheck. You're not open to coaching, feedback, and continuously improving your skills. You need constant direction or supervision to complete your work. You're not comfortable communicating, asking questions, or taking ownership of your responsibilities. Compensation & Earning Potential This position offers a competitive, guaranteed monthly base salary plus an additional monthly performance-based bonus. Your monthly bonus is tied to the performance and results of your work. In many cases your bonus can be larger than your base salary. We believe in rewarding people who consistently produce excellent work and contribute to the performance of our advertising campaigns. Working Schedule This is a full-time position, approximately 40 hours per week. Our core team works from 8 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time (approximately 2 PM to 11 PM Central European Time), Monday through Friday. After the initial 60-day training period, your schedule becomes more flexible as long as you're consistently meeting your performance targets. However, you'll still generally be expected to be available during the team's core working hours. Why Join Performance Rocket? Learn a valuable skill set: Develop expertise in direct-response marketing, copywriting, advertising psychology, and creative strategy. Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus. Hands-on experience: Work on real campaigns for major eCommerce brands rather than spending months on theoretical training. Learn from experienced marketers: Work alongside people who have generated hundreds of millions in sales. Room to grow: Develop into a professional copywriter, creative strategist, or other senior marketing role as your skills improve. Remote global team: Work with ambitious people from different backgrounds and locations. Performance-driven culture: Your growth and earning opportunities will be tied to the quality of your work, initiative, and results.

review_candidates.description: O Mêntore, instituição de pagamento com atuação em soluções para processamento de folha de pagamento e serviços financeiros, busca um profissional para desenvolver canais especializados e ampliar sua presença nacional em segmentos com potencial de contratação e movimentação de folha. Buscamos alguém com experiência comercial em mercados como agronegócio, serviços, supermercados e construção civil, capaz de transformar relacionamentos setoriais em parcerias, contratos e clientes ativos. Responsabilidades e atribuições Estruturar e liderar a estratégia nacional de canais nichados, desenvolvendo parceiros e oportunidades comerciais que ampliem a base de empresas e colaboradores atendidos pela Mêntore, com foco em receita, rentabilidade e relacionamento de longo prazo. Elaborar o plano comercial nacional por segmento, definindo mercados prioritários, regiões, parceiros, metas e ações de expansão. Prospectar, negociar e desenvolver canais de distribuição, como associações empresariais, sindicatos patronais, cooperativas, consultorias, escritórios contábeis e empresas de tecnologia para RH e folha. Construir propostas comerciais adequadas à realidade de cada setor, considerando concentração de colaboradores, dispersão geográfica, sazonalidade e processos de pagamento. Desenvolver relacionamento com empresários, diretores financeiros, gestores de RH, lideranças setoriais e decisores de grandes grupos. Conduzir negociações estratégicas, desde a identificação da oportunidade até a contratação e o acompanhamento da implantação. Recrutar, capacitar e acompanhar parceiros comerciais, estabelecendo planos conjuntos de geração de demanda e conversão. Liderar a equipe comercial dedicada aos segmentos, com gestão de metas, produtividade, desenvolvimento e desempenho. Gerenciar o funil de vendas e o forecast nacional, garantindo registros consistentes no CRM e previsibilidade dos fechamentos. Atuar com Marketing na organização de eventos setoriais, encontros com clientes, campanhas segmentadas e ações de prospecção. Coordenar com Implantação e Atendimento a transição dos contratos fechados para a operação, acompanhando a primeira folha e a ativação da base. Requisitos e qualificações Vivência em gestão comercial B2B, desenvolvimento de canais ou expansão de negócios com abrangência nacional ou multirregional. Histórico comprovado de resultados em um ou mais dos segmentos prioritários, com capacidade de desenvolver novas frentes. Experiência na formação, ativação e gestão de parceiros comerciais. Conhecimento da dinâmica de contratação dos setores atendidos e relacionamento com seus principais decisores. Vivência em vendas consultivas, negociações complexas e gestão de ciclos comerciais com múltiplos interlocutores. Experiência em liderança de equipes e acompanhamento de indicadores comerciais. Capacidade de analisar potencial de mercado, viabilidade comercial, receita e rentabilidade. Domínio de CRM, gestão de pipeline e elaboração de forecast. Formação superior em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes em território nacional. DIFERENCIAIS: Experiência em instituições de pagamento, bancos, fintechs, benefícios corporativos ou soluções de RH e folha. Relacionamento com entidades representativas, cooperativas e grupos empresariais dos segmentos prioritários. Experiência em estruturar uma operação comercial por segmentos desde sua implantação. Conhecimento das particularidades de folhas sazonais, equipes distribuídas e operações com grande volume de colaboradores. Histórico de expansão comercial por meio de associações, eventos e parcerias setoriais. review_candidates.description: We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects. We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions. Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline, subsea, process, and valves - all designed to help you optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency. With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way. Diversity & Inclusion EnerMech is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive organization. We believe that diversity enriches our team, and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, cultures, and identities. Ensure that key logistic requirements and consumables have been appropriately identified, so that the costs can be reliably forecast in the "As Mobilised" forecast Gross Profit Verify project revenue and cost baseline and ensure that any differences between the "As Bid" and "As-Mobilised" forecast Gross Profit are submitted to the Business Line VP for approval and sign-off Ensure the creation of the customer sales order in Navision with the approved WBS structure and ensure that a detailed revenue & cost budget along with all relevant milestones if applicable are correctly input Ensure the creation of Job Code in Navision with the approved WBS tasks and ensure the management of active(live) job codes in line with the phased execution of the project Ensure that the "As Mobilised" phased revenue and cost forecast is taken on into Mercury and BFT at the required level of granularity, reconciled to the approved budget baseline, before the project is released into execution Ensure that all timesheets and purchases are timely and correctly recorded on the project throughout the project execution phase Work with the Project Manager and Invoicing Coordinators to ensure the timely approval and invoicing of all work completed in line with contractual requirements / milestones and manage the prioritisation of invoicing where a factor is used Ensure that the Project Manager's signs-off monthly project performance including key KPI's, working capital, GP performance, project CAC and cashflow forecast if applicable Accountable for the integrity of the project forecast held Accountable for a single, reconciled version of the forecast, ensuring that the values held in Mercure and BFT agree, that Navision actuals reconcile to the forecast structure, and that any differences are identified, explained and resolved Ensure the effective financial close-out and archiving of project financial documentation Responsibilities Monitor commitments and accruals and track contingencies, provisions and management reserves Support the Project Manager in cost forecasting (EAC/ETC) and monitor project financial performance v budget & forecast, identify variances and establish root cause. Track customer PO cover and notify the Project Manager of potential breaches Implement cost control measures agreed by Project Manager as necessary Participate in deep-dive project reviews and analysis, supporting Finance Leadership and Project Managers with a clear view of forecast GP evolution verses previous forecast Work with business line teams to understand performance variances and coordinate with SSC to ensure accurate variance explanations in management reports. BS / Working Capital & follow-up reason for trends. Issue pack to PM by work day 3/4(EUR/AMEC) / work day 7/8(APAC/AMER) Run GP reviews with Project and Operations Managers, capturing key discussion points and agreed amendments or corrections, either at a job or service line level, to ensure revenue and costs are aligned. Identify and highlight financial trends, providing actionable insights to support decision-making.
